p: Bitcoin steht bei 83.231 Dollar, +2,2 Prozent in 24 Stunden und -0,1 Prozent in einer Woche.
Ethereum liegt bei 2.449 Dollar, +2,8 Prozent am Tag.
Der Gesamtmarkt ist 2,91 Billionen Dollar schwer, Bitcoin macht davon 57,5 Prozent aus.
Angst und Gier steht bei 63 von 100.
43 Prozent der 300 größten Coins liegen über ihrer 50-Tage-Linie, 41 Prozent über der 200-Tage-Linie.
Der durchschnittliche RSI liegt bei 41, also im mittleren Bereich.
Im Stablecoin-Markt liegen 304,2 Milliarden Dollar. In den letzten sieben Tagen sind 2,4 Milliarden Dollar abgeflossen.
In DeFi-Protokollen stecken 89,6 Milliarden Dollar. Vorn liegen Ethereum (50,6 Milliarden Dollar), Base (6,3 Milliarden Dollar), Solana (6,0 Milliarden Dollar).
Vorn liegt L1 mit +8,9 Prozent in sieben Tagen über 51 Coins.
Am schwächsten ist Gaming mit -5,6 Prozent.
Die Spanne zwischen stärkstem und schwächstem Sektor beträgt 14 Prozentpunkte. Es ist also kein Markt, in dem alles gleich läuft.
Die höchsten Gesamt-Scores haben BTC (76), JST (76), GMX (75).
Größte Tagesgewinner über 100 Millionen Marktkapitalisierung: TON +36210,6 Prozent, HEX +37,5 Prozent, CVX +20,1 Prozent.
Auffällige Divergenz bei BTC: Buzz 69, aber nur -0.1% in 7 Tagen. Die Aufmerksamkeit ist da, der Kurs noch nicht.
Beim Social Buzz führen AERO (91), QNT (86), CARDS (83).
Bei den Hidden Gems stehen oben: RPL (71), GMX (68), CAKE (69), SYRUP (68).
Eine Bitcoin-Überweisung kostet gerade 1 Satoshi pro Byte für die schnelle Bestätigung.
Die Rechenleistung im Netzwerk hat sich in 30 Tagen um +17 Prozent verändert.
Bis zur nächsten Halbierung der Blockbelohnung sind es noch 77.560 Blöcke. also rund 539 Tage.

btc.zyklus: Das letzte Bitcoin-Halving war am 20.04.2024, das ist 30 Monate her. Bitcoin steht 34 % unter dem Allzeithoch. In den bisherigen Zyklen kam das Hoch rund 12 bis 18 Monate nach dem Halving, danach folgte ein längerer Rücksetzer. Es sind nur 3 bis 4 Zyklen, die Aussage ist eine Hypothese und kein Naturgesetz.

stimmung.herde_text: Die Herde ist zuversichtlich. Noch kein Extrem, aber neue Käufe brauchen jetzt gute Gründe und einen Plan für den Rücksetzer.
lage: Angst und Gier steht bei 63 (Greed): keine Extremlage.
Stablecoin-Umlauf +66,8 Mio $ in 30 Tagen. Frisches Kapital im System.
Makro: Leitzins 3,88 %, Rendite 10 Jahre 5,15 %. Hohe Realzinsen belasten Risikoanlagen (Hypothese, die in vielen Phasen galt).

news.t: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.z: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

news.t: Malaysia central bank launches DLT platform for tokenized bonds
news.z: The platform tracks tokenized securities ownership and transfers, linking to Malaysia’s RENTAS+ system to settle corresponding payments in central bank money.

news.t: Tech giants rush to block 8 eMudhra certs that could enable fake sites
news.z: A private key generation flaw allowed anyone to guess them and forge HTTPS certificates for any website.

news.t: MoonPay, Upbit parent Dunamu explore collaboration on stablecoin payments, GIWA expansion
news.z: The companies also plan to explore ways to broaden global access to Dunamu's Ethereum Layer 2, GIWA chain.

news.t: Musk says SpaceX-Tesla merger a ‘good idea’ as AI revenue jumps ninefold
news.z: A merger would bring Tesla into the same corporate group as Grok developer SpaceXAI and social media platform X.

news.t: Qubic restarts blockchain, opens recovery claims after $1.4M hack
news.z: The network’s validators approved a recovery plan and opened claims until May 1, 2027.

news.t: People Are Vibe Coding the Ads Out of Their Smart TVs: Here's How
news.z: A viral Claude Code prompt lets Android TV owners switch off sponsored rows and tracking software and build their own home screens, with no root access and every change reversible.

news.t: OpenAI Buys Orchestra Bio to Put AI Agents in Charge of Drug Development Grunt Work
news.z: The ChatGPT maker is folding Orchestra’s drug-program agents into Rosalind, its life sciences suite, betting AI can shave time off the decade-plus it takes to bring a medicine to patients.

news.t: Utah AG sues Kalshi, pursues profits from prediction market company
news.z: Derek Brown likened the prediction market company to a “public nuisance“ that was “causing a significant and substantial ongoing harm“ to state residents.

news.t: JPMorgan Puts a Number on Bitcoin for the First Time: 10% a Year, With a Big Caveat
news.z: J.P. Morgan Asset Management’s 2027 Long-Term Capital Market Assumptions project a 10% annual return for Bitcoin over 10 to 15 years, though the firm isn’t adding it to its main portfolio models.

news.t: Liquid Network Announces Final Stages of Recovery Following Massive Hack
news.z: Bitcoin Magazine Liquid Network Announces Final Stages of Recovery Following Massive Hack One month after hackers pinched 4,000 bitcoins, the Liquid Network is up and running again. This post Liquid Network Announces Fin

news.t: Wallet Linked to Drift Exploit Sends $61 Million in Ethereum to Tornado Cash
news.z: The North Korea-linked attacker behind April's $295 million Drift heist pushed 25,700 ETH through the mixer in two hours, and still controls roughly $198 million more.

news.t: Bitwise, Hyperliquid seek SEC rule changes for token trading, airdrops
news.z: The firms are seeking clearer guidance on the classification of crypto assets and secondary-market trading as the SEC’s public comment period comes to a close.

news.t: Microsoft, Alphabet, Goldman Sachs Join Growing List of Companies Objecting to Tokenized Stocks
news.z: Sixteen companies have now objected to having their shares traded on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, up from nine just four days earlier, according to an updated public notice.

news.t: Bitcoin Treasury Strive Debuts New Preferred Stock With 15% Dividend
news.z: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Treasury Strive Debuts New Preferred Stock With 15% Dividend Strive’s second preferred stock offering, SATS, debuted Tuesday on the Nasdaq. This post Bitcoin Treasury Strive Debuts New Preferred

news.t: Crypto’s 2026 shutdown wave claims 82 projects. What went wrong?
news.z: Crypto projects are struggling to survive as falling revenues, depleted funding and security breaches force closures across DeFi, blockchain infrastructure and gaming.

news.t: Swiss Regulator Approves First Retail Fund That Holds Bitcoin Directly
news.z: FINMA waived the diversification rules for the fund but leaned hard on custody and investor-protection safeguards.

news.t: Crypto firms, Wall Street push SEC to revise Regulation Crypto Assets as comments close
news.z: As the SEC’s comment period on a cryptocurrency proposal draws to a close, digital asset firms and Wall Street institutions have thoughts.

news.t: Utah likens Kalshi to a ‘back-alley gambling den’ in lawsuit naming Susquehanna firms
news.z: Utah seeks to recover alleged gambling profits and block Kalshi bets across sports, politics and culture.

news.t: Bitcoin ETFs Post Their Best Day in Nearly a Month as BlackRock Does All the Buying
news.z: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs took in $526.7 million on Monday, their biggest day since Sept. 22. BlackRock's IBIT supplied all of it while Fidelity and Grayscale funds bled.

news.t: JPMorgan issues first long-term bitcoin return forecast, projecting 10% annually
news.z: J.P. Morgan Asset Management's first long-term bitcoin forecast projects a 10% annual return but flags 55% volatility as a barrier to portfolio adoption.

news.t: Strive closes $630M SATS IPO, leaves Bitcoin allocation unspecified
news.z: The Bitcoin treasury company could acquire an estimated 7,372 BTC with its net proceeds, potentially surpassing Metaplanet’s holdings if it allocates the full amount.
